title: One-dimensional and codimension one homology of metric manifolds
summary: We compare singular homology and homology via integral currents in metric spaces that are homeomorphic to smooth manifolds. For such spaces, we provide sufficient conditions that guarantee the existence of a surjective homomorphism from the codimension one homology group via integral currents to the codimension one singular homology group. Moreover, we show that a one-dimensional isoperimetric inequality for integral currents implies that the one-dimensional homology groups coincide.
